subject: Insurance
title: Special Investigation Units
description: A quick, practical guide to Special Investigation Units.

hook.text: Every major insurer has a Special Investigation Unit.

buildup.text: SIUs receive referrals from claims adjusters who spot red flags: inconsistent stories, suspicious timing.

discovery.text: Investigators interview witnesses, review medical records, analyze financial data, and conduct surveillance.

twist.text: Most fraud is never caught. Industry estimates suggest less than 20% of insurance fraud is detected.

climax.text: SIUs are insurance's first line of defense against fraud.

punchline.text: Ex-cops hunting fraud. SIUs protect honest policyholders from criminal claims.

quiz.question: What percentage of insurance fraud is estimated to be detected?
